name: Find_Orb paired regression protocol v2

amendment.scope: Forecast ephemerides only: set DISABLE_LIGHT_BENDING=1 for both forward-state and fitted-orbit forecasts so their differential solar light-deflection convention matches Horizons quantity 1.
amendment.sourceEvidence: Pinned Find_Orb 9cc932997837c5ab994fbf015db59f5d0da852e5, orb_func.cpp:702-722 documents the Horizons/CCD convention difference; ephem0.cpp:2640 temporarily disables light bending for ordinary ephemerides and restores it afterward.
amendment.fittingLimitation: The internal fitting observation model continues to include differential solar light deflection. Raw Horizons quantity 1 inputs omit it, so the inverse-fit benchmark retains a small convention mismatch and is not pure synthetic CCD astrometry. Fit truth errors remain report-only; forward ephemeris convention alignment does not remove this fitting limitation.
amendment.preserved: Corpus bytes, selected cases/arcs, physical-model applicability, force configuration, measurement/noise draws and all numeric tolerances are unchanged. Existing v1 outputs are retained under their original convention and source snapshots.

noise: exact or independent east/north Gaussian sigma 0.2 arcsec using the recorded SHA256-seeded LCG/Box-Muller generator. Seed is case ID + bank index + replicate; shared bank measurements are identical across nested arcs and both engines. MPC80 additionally rounds time to 0.000001 day, RA to 0.001 time-second and Dec to 0.01 arcsecond.

pairedAccuracyAllowance.policy: Report a degradation when candidate truth error exceeds baseline error * 1.1 + 0.1 arcsec. This predeclared screening allowance is not an accuracy guarantee, statistical significance test, or automatic science acceptance gate. Report by object class, arc and physical-model applicability.

sentinelPolicy: Frozen corpus suite.sentinelIds, one-hour arc with exact astrometry; also the one-week arc of the first sentinel ID, chosen without fit outcomes. Explicit --arcs replaces this assignment.
fullPolicy: All corpus cases and arcs, exact plus Gaussian noise, replicate 0. Full mode plans by default and requires --execute to run its potentially thousands of jobs.
checkSelection: Default --checks all runs independent forward-state controls and inverse fits. --checks forward runs source-model/propagation checks only; --checks fit skips the independent reference floor and must not claim complete scientific validation. Both omissions are explicit in the manifest, plan and summary.
referenceFloor: At every selected arc endpoint, propagate its independent Horizons truth state to that epoch and the +1/+3/+7-day targets. Strict cases use the broad 0.1-arcsecond guard; this is not an established universal physical accuracy. Model-limited cases still run and retain all numerical, time-grid, force-model and engine-parity gates, but their absolute Horizons discrepancy is reported separately without a false strict physical-equivalence claim.
fitGate: parity enforces paired sky-direction, range and primary-element agreement and matching observation use; report records disagreements when an intentionally changed solver is under investigation. Element absolute tolerances are 1e-6 AU for q, dimensionless for e, degrees for i, and AU^-1 for inverseA. These are broad regression guards, not established scientific accuracy. Truth errors and wrapped node/perihelion-angle differences are reported only; neither mode asserts true orbital-element recovery from underconstrained arcs. Structural and forward gates always remain active.
searchLimitations: fo-count and WASM have the same configured deterministic systematic-ranging batch capacity. Retries can exceed this capacity. Upstream outer differential-correction loops still contain wall/CPU-time limits, so whole-fit determinism is not guaranteed. Original native fo retains the upstream half-CPU-second ranging cap and is an optional diagnostic, never the exact-count parity authority.
timing: Sequential fresh-job timings are provenance, not a controlled performance benchmark. Dry-run scheduling estimate assumes 5 seconds per fit and 1 second per forward propagation, configurable and explicitly unmeasured.
